subject: Sentinel SI sprint: allocate rehearsal/demo lanes and buffer windows for APAC marketplace co-sell
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Naoko Sato <naoko.sato@sentinel-sys.com>, ops@sentinel-sys.com
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 02:12:00 +0000
Subject: Sentinel SI sprint: allocate rehearsal/demo lanes and buffer windows for APAC marketplace co-sell

Hi Naoko / Sentinel ops,

Thanks again for partnering on the APAC co-sell. We want to lock a rehearsal cadence ahead of the marketplace showcase to avoid last-minute timezone clashes — customer calendar already looks tight. Proposal below:

- Primary rehearsal (60m): prefer 2028-06-20 09:00–10:00 SGT or 2028-06-21 14:00–15:00 JST
- Technical dry-run (30m) with SI + AWS SA: any day in the week prior, recommend a 0900 SGT slot
- Demo (45m): target 2028-06-28 09:30–10:15 SGT (customer constraint)
- Buffer lanes: reserve two 30m buffer lanes the day before the demo (for runbook smoke and last-minute slides)

Attached is a first draft runbook (sentinel_runbook_v1.pdf). Can you confirm the SI presenter list and whether Jessica from AWS should join the technical dry-run? If there are hard calendar restrictions on your side, flag them and we can propose fallbacks.

Next steps:
- Naoko: confirm preferred rehearsal window and SI presenters
- Vanessa: can you coordinate AWS SA availability and reserve buffer lanes on our calendar once we have confirmation?
- Karthik: confirm which SI engineers will be in the technical dry-run

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
mobile +1 415-555-0192

From: Naoko Sato <naoko.sato@sentinel-sys.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@sentinel-sys.com
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:03:00 +0900
Subject: Re: Sentinel SI sprint: allocate rehearsal/demo lanes and buffer windows for APAC marketplace co-sell

Hi Markus / Vanessa,

Thanks — the windows you proposed work in principle. A couple of notes from the SI side:

- Our lead engineer (Taro Ishikawa) is in a client sprint 2028-06-20 morning SGT, so the 09:00 SGT rehearsal on 20th is tight. 21st 14:00 JST would be better for the full run-through.
- For the technical dry-run we do need an AWS SA present to validate the IAM/network bits; please loop in the AWS contact.
- The external customer (Evergreen Logistics) requested the demo to be 45m — we can compress the flow but would like a 15m Q&A buffer immediately after the main slot.

I'll pull the presenter list together and attach the names tomorrow. Also, can you add a 30-minute slack rehearsal window the morning of the demo for a final smoke check?

Best,
Naoko Sato
Program Lead, Sentinel Systems
Attachments: none in this message

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Naoko Sato <naoko.sato@sentinel-sys.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, Jessica Lam <jessica.lam@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Jun 2028 01:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Sentinel SI sprint: allocate rehearsal/demo lanes and buffer windows for APAC marketplace co-sell

Great — thanks Naoko. Looping in Jessica from AWS to confirm SA availability for the dry-run.

To consolidate:
- Full rehearsal: 2028-06-21 14:00–15:00 JST (confirmed by SI tentative)
- Technical dry-run (AWS SA + SI): 2028-06-24 09:00–09:30 SGT (proposed)
- Demo: 2028-06-28 09:30–10:15 SGT + 15m immediate Q&A buffer 10:15–10:30 SGT
- Slack smoke check: 2028-06-28 08:45–09:15 SGT
- Buffer lanes (reserve on calendar): 2028-06-27 16:00–16:30 SGT & 2028-06-28 12:00–12:30 SGT

I've attached a calendar stub (calendar_event.ics) for the primary rehearsal and will create the calendar events once all parties confirm. Karthik — can you confirm the presenter_list.xlsx (who will demo which segment) and whether we need an extra SI engineer in the Q&A?

If no objections I will block the buffer lanes on our shared Redwood calendar and send the invites to Sentinel + AWS.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: calendar_event.ics

Confirmed presenters: Taro Ishikawa (SI lead) — overview + integration, Priya (SI engineer) — demo walkthrough, Karthik Iyer (Redwood) — runtime/ops + cost slides. We should add an extra SI engineer for live troubleshooting; I'll ask Sentinel to confirm.

Also marking fallback: if 21st JST falls through, propose 2028-06-22 10:00–11:00 JST as an alternate.

Karthik

Thanks team — approved. Vanessa, please go ahead and lock the rehearsal (2028-06-21 14:00 JST) and the dry-run with AWS SA (24th 09:00 SGT). Karthik — once Sentinel confirms the extra SI engineer, slack me the name and I will approve calendar invites to the Evergreen Logistics stakeholders.

One more ask: can someone upload the final pre-demo checklist to the shared runbook folder and paste the link here? I'll do a final pass on the runbook once that's in place.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — I want this to be clean for the marketplace slot.

— Markus
